messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-INC-10294 - inference-prod-high-5xx-rate (severity: P1). Trigger: 5xx rate > 3% for 2m. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-INC-10294
pagerduty: Page fired to on-call: @marco ramos, @sarah chen
marco ramos: Acked via PD. I'm taking ownership, tagging @sarah as secondary. Starting triage.
sarah chen: Saw it, joining. quick Q: is this multi-region? I see spike only in eu-west-1 in Datadog.
tj nguyen: Adding logs — seeing lots of "KV cache miss" and internal 500s from runtime. Pasting a snippet.
tj nguyen: ```json
{"time":"2026-03-14T09:12:03Z","service":"runtime","level":"error","msg":"unhandled exception: model_runner: failed to allocate kv cache"}
```
marco ramos: Ok looks like memory pressure on the model-host pool. Checking autoscaler and pod OOMs.
lia park: Customer-impact: support queue has two tickets citing timeouts; no major outage reported yet. CC'ing AE for affected accounts.
jen devops: Checked nodes: two GPU hosts in eu-west-1 at 98% memory, kube evicted a few pods around 09:10. Doing a temporary scale-up now (k8s: scale deployment inference-runtime --replicas +2).
sarah chen: Good. Also enabling fallback routing to smaller quantized model for requests >512 tokens. Command: 
```bash
redwood route update --policy=failover --from=model-prod-v1 --to=model-prod-lite-v1 --region=eu-west-1
```
incident-bot: Escalation: no ack from secondary after 5m, paging @tj nguyen.
tj nguyen: Confirmed, applying hotfix to reduce KV cache allocation. Patch pushed to canary (rev: hotfix-2254). Monitoring.
marco ramos: Can we get a quick status on error rate? Datadog shows 5xx: 3.8% -> down to 2.1% after scale-up.
lia park: Note for postmortem: include customers affected, timeline, and mitigation (scale-up + failover). AE requests ETA for full resolution.
sarah chen: ETA ~20-30m to stabilize and roll a proper config change. I'll post updates every 5.
marco ramos: Handing off to @sarah for the next 2h; I'll stay available for escalation. If error rate rebounds >3% reassign to me. Handoff at 09:30 UTC.
sarah chen: Taking over. Summary for handoff: PD-INC-10294, suspected root cause: memory pressure on eu-west-1 model hosts causing KV cache allocation failures; mitigations applied: +2 replicas, fallback routing to model-prod-lite-v1, hotfix deployed to canary. Monitoring & customer comms in progress.
incident-bot: Thread marked resolved by @marco ramos. If new alerts appear we'll reopen this thread.
